facts.business: SML Mahindra Limited (formerly SML Isuzu Limited) manufactures and sells commercial vehicles, including buses and trucks, in India.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to incentive or external pressure to meet expectations resulting in revenue being overstated or recognized before goods are accepted by customers
facts.related_party_note: Proposed related party transactions with Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (promoter holding 58.97%) for FY 2026-27 aggregating Rs. 719.51 crores, including purchase of goods/services (Rs. 389.51 cr), sale of goods/services (Rs. 0.00 cr), royalty/technical fees (Rs. 0.00 cr), brand/trademark license fee (Rs. 1 lac per annum), services rendered (Rs. 10.00 cr), and borrowings/ICDs (Rs. 320.00 cr). Transactions to be at arm's length using cost-plus margin methodology and comparable uncontrolled pricing.
